text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer, more sustained paragraphs with topic development","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how clearly the writing is arranged into sections with an introduction, body points, and a conclusion."},{"evidence":"“Firstly,” “Secondly,” “However,” “On the other hand”","quality":"cohesion","description":"This captures the use of transition words and logical connectors that guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"“encouragement to cheating,” “technological integration,” “limitations in place”","quality":"idea development","description":"This captures fuller explanation of reasons and counterarguments rather than brief, repetitive claims."},{"evidence":"“Many are addicted to social media,” “daily grades get better, but when test day arrives”","quality":"sentence complexity","description":"This captures the use of more varied and extended sentence structures to express cause, contrast, and consequence."},{"evidence":"“loose focus,” “student’s attention,” “educational time”","quality":"word choice","description":"This captures more precise and academic vocabulary for discussing the issue."},{"evidence":"“cellphones should not be allowed” followed by a concession paragraph","quality":"argument control","description":"This captures a more controlled presentation of a claim, acknowledging the other side before returning to the writer’s position."}]}
